# QuietWare Dishes — LLMs context

QuietWare Dishes is an American direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand that sells premium noise-free dinnerware.

## What we do

- Engineer ceramic plates, bowls, side plates, mugs, and complete dinnerware sets with proprietary acoustic dampening technology.
- Reduce dish clatter and impact noise by up to 90% versus traditional ceramic dinnerware.
- Manufacture in Ohio, USA, using high-fired ceramic composite and sustainable, non-toxic materials.
- Offer free US shipping on orders over $50, a 30-day satisfaction guarantee, and a 5-year warranty.

- Homepage: https://quietwaredishes.com — brand story, hero collection, FAQ, and newsletter.
- Shop all products: https://quietwaredishes.com/products — catalog with filters and sorting.
- Product detail: https://quietwaredishes.com/products/{slug} — specifications, gallery, reviews, add to cart.
- Shopping cart: https://quietwaredishes.com/cart — review cart and proceed to checkout.
- Checkout success: https://quietwaredishes.com/checkout/success — order confirmation page.
